data.one_liner: Shows customizable context menus on right‑click or long‑press.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ContextMenuOverlay and ContextMenuRegion widgets to display menus when the user right‑clicks or long‑presses. Menus can be built from supplied templates or fully custom widgets and styled via button and card builders.
use_when: You need a lightweight, cross‑platform context‑menu solution for desktop/web/mobile
You want to customise menu appearance and behaviour without writing your own overlay logic
avoid_when: You already use a full UI kit that includes its own menu system
You require advanced animations or platform‑native menu integrations
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS and Linux
Highly customizable styling via buttonStyle, cardBuilder and buttonBuilder
Simple API with ready‑made Link, Text and Generic menus
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter widgets; no native OS menu look‑and‑feel
No built‑in animation options for menu transitions
